description: This file defines the PersistableOrder class, representing an entity for orders that includes customer info and order items, with serialization support.

classes.name: PersistableOrder
classes.description: Java class representing a persistable order with customer and product item associations.

methods.name: setOrderProductItems
methods.description: Sets the list of products in the order.

methods.name: getOrderProductItems
methods.description: Retrieves the list of products in the order.

methods.name: setCustomer
methods.description: Assigns a customer to the order.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves the customer associated with the order.

methods.name: isShipToBillingAdress
methods.description: Checks if the order is set to ship to the billing address.

methods.name: setShipToBillingAdress
methods.description: Sets whether to ship to the billing address.
